in_marathi.name: Nayakan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nayakan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A Nayakan is a leader, a hero, a commander, or a patron. This name is derived from the Tamil word 'nāyaka', which means 'leader', 'hero', or 'commander'. In Hindu mythology, Nayakan is also the name of a god associated with war and heroism.
